data.title: 蕾塞 · 深夜学校泳池·月下水波与轻盈出水
data.description: 【蕾塞 · 深夜学校泳池·月下水波与轻盈出水】夏夜万籁俱寂的学校露天泳池里，清澈的池水在月色下荡漾着粼粼波光。身穿深蓝连体死库水的蕾塞宛如美人鱼般破水而出，抹开脸上的水珠在月下仰起笑靥——「游泳一点都不难对吧？电次君，如果明天我们一起逃走……去一个没有人认识我们的地方生活，好不好？」
data.promptProse: Reze steps out of the deserted school pool into the midnight air, shaking water from her hair with a light laugh. Her dark-navy school swimsuit and choker retain the outfit. The cowboy view places the pool edge below her and empty tiled lanes receding behind. Silver moonlight illuminates hair droplets and the raised water surface, while wavering pool reflections touch the tiles beside the darker exit ledge.
data.camera: cowboy shot, stepping out of the moonlit school pool
